items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: Well Woody wasn’t in his class. Woody was a lovely man, but he wasn’t in a class with Benny.

ctx.x: He did something for Woody Herman too I think.

Well Woody wasn’t in his class. Woody was a lovely man, but he wasn’t in a class with Benny. And there are so many, they still won’t let him die. There are still guys going around. But people loved it in Japan, and paid hundreds and hundreds of dollars to come and dance for half an hour or so and then listen to a concert. And Peanuts Hucko was a good clarinet player, he does a good Benny Goodman. I told Peanuts several times, I said, “Peanuts, you’re not mean enough to be Benny Goodman.” He said, “Yeah, I’ll be…
Just fire some people for old times sake. Just pretend.
